# Card payment and refund

## State machine

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    Initiated
    Authorised
    FundsCaptured
    RefundRequested
    Refunded
    Disputed
    ChargedBack
    Declined
    Voided
    [*] --> Initiated
    RefundRequested --> Refunded : ApproveRefund [role = FinanceApprover and assigned] / Audit:RefundIssued, Notification:RefundConfirmed
    Initiated --> Authorised : AuthoriseCard [role = Gateway] / Audit:PaymentAuthorised
    Authorised --> FundsCaptured : CaptureFunds [role = Gateway] / Audit:FundsCaptured, Notification:ReceiptSent
    Initiated --> Declined : DeclineCard [role = Gateway] / Audit:PaymentDeclined, Notification:CustomerToldDeclined
    FundsCaptured --> Disputed : OpenDispute [role = Gateway] / Audit:DisputeOpened, Notification:FinanceAlerted
    Disputed --> ChargedBack : LoseDispute [role = FinanceApprover and assigned] / Audit:ChargebackAccepted, Notification:MerchantToldChargeback
    RefundRequested --> FundsCaptured : RejectRefund [role = SupportRep] / Audit:RefundRejected, Notification:CustomerToldRefundRejected
    FundsCaptured --> RefundRequested : RequestRefund [role = Customer and assigned] / Audit:RefundRequested
    Authorised --> Voided : VoidAuthorisation [role = SupportRep] / Audit:AuthorisationVoided, Notification:CustomerToldVoided
    Disputed --> FundsCaptured : WinDispute [role = FinanceApprover and assigned] / Audit:DisputeWon
    Refunded --> [*]
    ChargedBack --> [*]
    Declined --> [*]
    Voided --> [*]
```

classDiagram
    class Payment {

    }
    class Order {
        +orderNumber : String [1] maxLength=20
        +total : Real [1]

    class Merchant {
        +accountId : String [1] maxLength=30
        +name : String [1] maxLength=200
    }
    class Dispute {
        +caseNumber : String [1] maxLength=30
        +reasonCode : String [1] maxLength=10
        +respondBy : Date [1]
    }
    class PaymentCurrency {
        <<enumeration>>
        AUD
        EUR
        GBP
        USD
    }
    class PaymentRefundReason {
        <<enumeration>>
        Damaged
        NotReceived
        ChangedMind
        Duplicate
    }
    Payment "0..*" --> "1" Order : order
    Payment "0..*" --> "1" Merchant : merchant
    Payment "1" *-- "0..1" Dispute : dispute
    note for Payment "One card payment for one order. It keeps only the last four card digits, never the card number."
